label: itch.io

target.empty: the user creates the game's page on itch.io first; the target is the two parts of its address — `user/game` for https://user.itch.io/game

tool.name: butler
tool.missing: the user installs it from https://itch.io/docs/butler/ and puts it on PATH (or sets the environment variable BUTLER to the executable)

login.missing: the user runs `butler login` in a terminal (it opens a browser); in CI, set the environment variable BUTLER_API_KEY

after: https://{user}.itch.io/{game} — a channel uploaded for the first time is switched on in the page's settings (Edit game → Uploads)
